      "snippet": "Yeah, this is a good pivot. Let’s answer the narrow question first and then plug it into your bigger plan.

1. Can I read a Google Doc that’s “published to the web”?
Yes.
If you:

Make a Google Doc (or Sheet).

Use File → Share → Publish to web.

Get a public URL (no login required).

Then any browsing-capable model (like me with web access) can read that URL like a normal web page.
Key points from Google’s own docs:

“Publish to web” creates a public, anonymous HTML view of the doc or sheet.
